title: Ruriiro no Yuki
overview:
Entrusting my feelings... to a single snowflake...

Ruriiro no Yuki is a romance adventure. You play a young scientist who has lost both his parents. Shrugging off rumors that it is haunted, he rents a cheap room, and inside it finds a mysterious jar. Out of the jar comes Ruri, a snow spirit with blonde hair and blue eyes who dresses in traditional Japanese clothes. She remembers nothing of her life before she was sealed away and has nowhere else to go. Move around town on an overhead map, talk with the people you meet and choose your replies to win the heart of the girl you like - Ruri will cheer you on whoever you choose. Finishing the game and making a final save opens up extra options.

- First-print limited edition with an original hologram sticker
- Single player
- Memory backup save
- Rated for ages 18 and over

ひとひらの雪に…　想いをよせて…
